title: Duct classification.
officialText:
Ducts shall be classified based on the maximum operating pressure of the duct at pressures of positive or
negative 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0 or 10.0 inches of water column. The pressure classification of ducts shall equal or exceed the
design pressure of the air distribution in which the ducts are utilized.
